multi-agent.title: Multi-agent collaboration
cues: Give one lead Agent a clear software task.
As work unfolds, the lead brings each specialist into the same Chat.
A user experience specialist clarifies the interaction. A developer implements it, with progress visible in the conversation.
Quality assurance verifies the result without opening another Chat.
One shared conversation reaches a reviewed pull request.

context-tree.title: Context Tree
cues: Context Tree carries durable team knowledge from one task into the next.
Before work begins, an Agent reads only the relevant, authorized paths.
Settled constraints guide design, code, and tests without replacing verification.
Temporary implementation detail stays with the code. Lasting decisions become source-backed proposals for a dedicated Context Reviewer.
Once approved, the shared snapshot helps every future Agent start smarter.

github.title: GitHub automation
cues: Connect one GitHub repository to First Tree.
Assigning an Issue creates or reuses its Source Chat, then wakes the teammate's Delegate Agent.
The Issue context travels with the work, without rebuilding the task.
A linked pull request stays attached to the same Issue Chat.
Review feedback, updates, approval, and merge events return automatically, preserving the work's history.
